description: Search decisions of Korea's Tax Tribunal (조세심판원; appeals against tax assessments) by keyword, newest decision first. Search terms must be in Korean. Decisions are not law but rulings on individual cases. Use the first number of each result (not the claim number) as the id for get_tax_tribunal.

query.description: Korean words in the case title. E.g. 양도소득세 비사업용 토지
